$comment: Every foreign-table write the legacy core still performs (01-TARGET.md §2.3 item 3, ADR-003; seeded from 00-ASSESSMENT.md §2.1 and 02-MIGRATION-PLAN.md §11). Keyed on {table, writer} where writer is '<file>#<symbol>' or '<file>#<METHOD> <route path>' for anonymous route handlers — never a line number. This list only shrinks: tests/serviceBoundaries.test.ts refuses any entry absent from tests/fixtures/tolerance.snapshot.json and any writer symbol that no longer exists. removed_in names the plan slice that deletes the entry.
